autonomous_prs.note: counts bead/* PRs with no commits after opening, by any author — not a measure of human intervention

final_gate_pass.note: state of checks at merge, not the first attempt: /check-runs returns filter=latest, so a failed-then-rerun PR counts as green. Structurally near 1.0 — do not read it as first-pass.

review_round_trips.why: review happens locally (ADR 0002/0013); GitHub review events do not exist in this workflow

rework_commits_after_open.why: squash-merge workflow: commit dates precede PR creation, so this is structurally 0
